caption:
some disability reminders today! 🥰💜

-disability and health are inherently political - ignoring this fact within your advocacy is counterproductive 🍃

-work does not equal worth - not being able to work or study because of your disability or health does not define you 💜

-accessibility is not special treatment - it means disabled people can leave their house safely and experience life ⭐️

-disability can impact anyone at any age - there is no such thing as being ‘too young’ to be disabled 🌸

-disability is not a taboo topic - disabled people don’t need to hide their experiences to make you more comfortable 🌙

-disabled people don’t owe you their medical info - stop asking strangers random invasive questions 🫠

all artwork is drawn by me - please do not repost my content onto your page without tagging me for credit. stories are okay of course! thank you 💜
